1: ## 1. Project Setup
2: 
3: - [x] 1.1 Add dependencies: `react`, `react-dom`, `zustand`, `@types/react`, `@types/react-dom`, `@vitejs/plugin-react`, `typescript`
4: - [x] 1.2 Create `vite.config.ts` with React plugin and entry point pointing to `index.html`
5: - [x] 1.3 Create `tsconfig.json` with strict mode, JSX preserve, and path aliases
6: - [x] 1.4 Replace root `index.html` with Vite entry point (`<div id="root">`, `<script type="module" src="/src/main.tsx">`)
7: - [x] 1.5 Create `src/` directory structure: `engine/`, `components/`
8: 
9: ## 2. State Store
10: 
11: - [x] 2.1 Create `src/store.ts` with `TextObject` interface (all fields from spec including `thickness`, `highlightColor`)
12: - [x] 2.2 Implement `addObject` action (creates object with defaults, positioned at stage center)
13: - [x] 2.3 Implement `selectObject(id | null)`, `updateObject(id, patch)`, `deleteObject(id)` actions
14: - [x] 2.4 Implement `setGlyphSet`, `setAnimating`, `setCanvasBackground` actions
15: - [x] 2.5 Verify store state is JSON-serializable (no class instances)
16: 
17: ## 3. Canvas Engine
18: 
19: - [x] 3.1 Create `src/engine/measure.ts` with `measureText`, `BOUND_PAD_X`, `BOUND_PAD_Y` (ported from `main.js`)
20: - [x] 3.2 Create `src/engine/draw.ts` with `drawHighlight`, `instantDraw`, `redrawAll` (ported from `main.js`)
21: - [x] 3.3 Update `instantDraw` signature to accept `animatorMap: Map<string, HandwritingAnimator>` instead of reading from object
22: - [x] 3.4 Export all engine functions and constants from `src/engine/index.ts`
23: - [x] 3.5 Verify engine functions are callable outside React (plain module imports work)
24: 
25: ## 4. Stage Component
26: 
27: - [x] 4.1 Create `src/components/Stage.tsx` with canvas `ref` and 16:9 aspect-ratio container
28: - [x] 4.2 Initialize canvas in `useEffect` on mount and on window resize (`initCanvas` logic)
29: - [x] 4.3 Expose canvas ref to parent via `useImperativeHandle` or pass ref down from `App`
30: - [x] 4.4 Render `<ObjectHandle>` for each text object in the store as overlay divs
31: - [x] 4.5 Add click handler on canvas/container to call `selectObject(null)` on background click
32: 
33: ## 5. ObjectHandle Component
34: 
35: - [x] 5.1 Create `src/components/ObjectHandle.tsx` accepting `obj: TextObject` as prop
36: - [x] 5.2 Compute handle position and size using `measureText` and `BOUND_PAD` constants
37: - [x] 5.3 Apply CSS: `opacity: 0` default, `opacity: 1` on `:hover`, dashed border when not selected, solid when `.selected`
38: - [x] 5.4 Implement drag with `onPointerDown` + `setPointerCapture` + `onPointerMove` + `onPointerUp`
39: - [x] 5.5 On drag: call `updateObject` with new x/y and trigger canvas redraw via rAF
40: - [x] 5.6 On click (no drag): call `selectObject(obj.id)`
41: - [x] 5.7 Verify handle size updates when `obj.text` or `obj.capHeight` changes
42: 
43: ## 6. Properties Panel
44: 
45: - [x] 6.1 Create `src/components/PropertiesPanel.tsx` as outer panel shell (280px, flex column)
46: - [x] 6.2 Create `src/components/PanelControls.tsx` with all per-object controls: text input, capHeight slider, speed slider, thickness slider, color picker, highlight checkbox + picker, pixelDensity slider
47: - [x] 6.3 Wire each control to call `updateObject` on the store and trigger canvas redraw if `state === 'done'`
48: - [x] 6.4 Add Animate button: transitions object to `animating`, calls `redrawAll`, draws highlight, awaits `animator.write()`, sets state to `done`
49: - [x] 6.5 Add Clear button: sets object state to `idle`, calls `redrawAll` without the object
50: - [x] 6.6 Add Delete button: calls `deleteObject`, triggers full redraw, panel returns to placeholder
51: - [x] 6.7 Create `src/components/CanvasSettings.tsx` with canvas background color picker (always visible); on change calls `setCanvasBackground` and `redrawAll`
52: - [x] 6.8 Show placeholder message when no object is selected; hide per-object controls
53: - [x] 6.9 Add "New Text" button calling `addObject` action
54: 
55: ## 7. Animator Instance Management
56: 
57: - [x] 7.1 Create a `animatorMapRef = useRef<Map<string, HandwritingAnimator>>()` in `App` or `Stage`
58: - [x] 7.2 On `addObject`: create a new `HandwritingAnimator(canvas, glyphSet)` and add to map
59: - [x] 7.3 On `deleteObject`: remove the corresponding entry from the map
60: - [x] 7.4 Pass `animatorMapRef.current` to all engine draw calls
61: 
62: ## 8. App Shell & GlyphSet Loading
63: 
64: - [x] 8.1 Create `src/App.tsx` rendering `<Stage>` and `<PropertiesPanel>` in two-column flex layout
65: - [x] 8.2 Create `src/main.tsx` mounting `<App>` into `#root`
66: - [x] 8.3 In `App`, fetch `./tim-hand.json` on mount (`useEffect`) and call `setGlyphSet` when resolved
67: - [x] 8.4 Migrate global CSS from `generator/styles.css` to project root or `src/styles.css`
68: 
69: ## 9. Verification & Cleanup
70: 
71: - [x] 9.1 Verify: page loads with no console errors, stage fills viewport, panel is 280px
72: - [x] 9.2 Verify: New Text creates object, handle appears on hover as bounding box
73: - [x] 9.3 Verify: drag repositions object, canvas redraws in real time
74: - [x] 9.4 Verify: Animate plays animation with sound, object state becomes done
75: - [x] 9.5 Verify: thickness slider changes stroke weight on redraw
76: - [x] 9.6 Verify: highlight checkbox shows/hides background rect
77: - [x] 9.7 Verify: canvas background picker changes fill color immediately
78: - [x] 9.8 Verify: Delete removes object from canvas and panel
79: - [x] 9.9 Remove `generator/main.js` and any other now-unused files from `generator/`
80: - [x] 9.10 Confirm build output (`vite build`) produces a static bundle with no errors
